title: Pineapple And Banana Smoothie
summary: On mornings that require an extra pick-me-up, I start with this pineapple and banana smoothie. It is creamy, refreshing, and only takes 5 minutes to make.
steps: Add all ingredients into a high-speed food processor and blend until smooth.
Adjust sweetness and thickness to suit your preferred tastes.
